scene: The window as the drill sheet found it last month, with no night running: three nights the platform archiver sealed before the filer went in, under the two generations the ops key file lists, and two of the plain .sql.gz the job has written since. The vault's tier move renamed two of the five on its way through — one came out of the move without its .enc and one came out of it with an .enc it never had. Rob works down the sheet and opens whichever nights the sample picks.
